text:
Lina Gomez: Quick pulse on Portfolio Alpha onboarding — spotting a streaming tail issue this week.

Lina Gomez: Snapshot (rdx-13b-q4):
```
route: /api/chat.stream
p95: 220ms
p99: 1820ms
errors: 0.6%
avg tokens: 48

route: /api/chat.sync
p95: 210ms
p99: 340ms
errors: 0.2%
```
Spend +8% (7d), usage steady. First notable spike Tue morning. Not sure if this is batching, fallback, or GPU contention. :eyes:

Ravi Patel: Thanks Lina — can you drop the account IDs and whether KV cache is enabled? Also are these requests multi-turn long-context ones or single-shot?

Lina Gomez: Accounts: alpha-1, alpha-2, alpha-3. All multi-turn chat, streaming used for incremental tokens. KV cache enabled but TTL is low (30s) for these customers.

Sam Ortiz: I'll take infra look. Any autoscale events or GPU evictions around Tue 03:10-03:20 UTC? If fallback to CPU happened that'd explain 1.8s p99.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: scaled up +2 nodes in cluster-portfolio-alpha at 2024-10-15T03:14:12Z (reason: queue depth spike)

Tess Nguyen: Could also be batching config for streaming — we keep small micro-batches which means more per-token overhead. If fallback policy triggered (e.g., model variant unavailable) it might have hit CPU path. Can you paste a couple of traces?

Lina Gomez: Pasting two short traces:
```
trace alpha-1: stream->route->queued_for_batch (55ms)->batch_dispatch->gpu_decode (210ms)->stream_flush
trace alpha-2: stream->route->queued_for_batch (1ms)->fallback_to_cpu_decode (1700ms)
```

Ravi Patel: Good catch — alpha-2 is the one with p99. I'll run a quick bench with higher cache TTL (5m) and bump stream batch size to see effect. If p99 drops we push config change.

Sam Ortiz: I'll grep node logs for OOM/evict and check GPU utilization for that window. If autoscaler scaled, there may have been transient pressure while nodes spun up. Will report in 30m.

Tess Nguyen: For enablement: recommend customers extend KV cache TTL for multi-turn session to avoid repeated full decodes, and set streaming batch size to 8->16 where latency budgets allow. I'll draft a short note for the onboarding guide.

Lina Gomez: Risk/renewals: currently low — usage growth is positive and they value low latency. But need to show we're proactively reducing tail. I'll schedule a quick sync with alpha-2 PM after we verify mitigation.

Sam Ortiz: Infra check done: saw GPU 95% for ~90s and one node restarted due to kubelet restart around 03:13. That aligns w/ the autoscaler event. Suggest we add cushion policy or faster scale up for this pool.

Ravi Patel: Repro bench results: with TTL 5m + batch size 12 => p99 stream drops from 1820ms -> 420ms in our test harness. Good win.

Lina Gomez: Nice. Action items:
- Sam: submit infra follow-up PR for pool cushion + investigate kubelet restart (ETA EOD).
- Ravi: roll config patch to alpha staging (TTL 5m, batch 12) and monitor for 24h.
- Tess: update onboarding doc + send short best-practices note to alpha PMs.

Tess Nguyen: I'll craft the note and include the bench numbers + recommended defaults. :memo:

Lina Gomez: Thanks team — will update customer and mark as 'monitoring' in the CS tracker. Back here next weekly with metrics unless we see regression. :thumbsup:
